name: 静默侧轨
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity minimalist desktop web app compositional concept, 1440x1000
Primary request: Create a simpler redesign option D, quiet rail, for the Chinese computer-science learning platform 词元研究所. Keep a restrained science-fiction mainframe character, but remove visual noise, excessive telemetry, ticks, brackets, and boxed frames.
Scene/backdrop: full desktop app viewport, no device frame, matte charcoal-black surface.
Subject: a calm 208px left navigation rail and three functional regions: a thin header, one large current-task region 今日任务 / Python 函数, and three quiet horizontal course rows for C语言, Python, 数据结构.
Style/medium: polished minimalist product UI, modern mainframe console distilled to essential geometry.
Composition/framing: generous negative space, asymmetric task layout, flat sections separated by one-pixel rules, one focal action.
Color palette: near-black, graphite, soft white, one selectable ion-cyan accent active. No red frames.
Constraints: minimal interface; maximum three major content regions; no decorative charts, circular charts, dense system readouts, nested frames, gradients, huge slogan, floating pill clusters, purple, red, illustration, or watermark.
